verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs list iTerm2-compatible image protocol support and a built-in `imgcat` command for outputting images to the terminal, which covers the core of inline image display via a documented protocol. One community report says the image support does not work well under tmux, which is a context-specific limitation rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth protocol documentation beyond one-line feature mentions, evidence of other graphics protocols (e.g. kitty or sixel) or richer graphics, and hands-on verification of image rendering, including inside multiplexers like tmux.
